issue.title: E3 (instruction migration): Explicit instruction delivery cutover
issue.description: Every SASE root agent on Claude, Codex, Grok, and Muse (unless its trust spike fails) gets its memory-built instruction bundle exactly once through an explicit adapter channel, with SASE-owned native instruction files suppressed. Claude helpers get the helper bundle. Each provider switch has a per-provider sunset kill switch and an atomic per-invocation legacy fallback. A trustworthy scoreboard, `sase instructions show`, and a handoff-aware readout prove the result and support the soak.

payload.entry:
Sanitized CLI probe evidence for the E3 provider spikes

@attachment:E3_SPIKE_RESULTS.md

E3 SPIKE RESULTS: Claude Code 2.1.296 — pass: exact-path `claudeMdExcludes` suppressed workspace and home root files; excluding only CLAUDE.md also prevented AGENTS.md fallback, so no `instructionFiles` override is needed. Nested linked-repo CLAUDE.md with `@AGENTS.md` and nested tools/AGENTS.md still loaded on read. 20 KB `--append-system-prompt-file` and `--append-subagent-system-prompt-file` each appeared in their respective snapshots; helper had no root marker, and `--resume` retained the root snapshot. `autoMemoryEnabled: false` and `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY=1` both yielded snapshots without an auto-memory section; prefer the per-run setting. Codex CLI 0.162.1 — pass: on a managed fixture, `-c project_doc_max_bytes=0` suppressed project AGENTS.md while 20 KB `developer_instructions` remained; an unmanaged fixture retained its own AGENTS.md without the override. Allowlist-shadow `codex exec` succeeded and wrote rollout to real `~/.codex/sessions` without stale-path errors. No real-home state was linked; Codex created local SQLite files in the shadow during execution (including `memories_1.sqlite`), not symlinks. Multi-agent v2 fork child: unprobed. Muse Code 1.4.7 — pass without `--trust-workspace`: project AGENTS.md was skipped, user skills listed with activation on, and a completed model run successfully used shell and file-edit tools. Grok 1.0.52 — pass: `GROK_MEMORY=0` yielded `prompt_context.json` with `memory_v2_enabled: false` and `agents_md_files: []`; the `--max-turns 1` CLI then exited with “max turns reached,” after writing that evidence. Sanitized evidence attached as E3_SPIKE_RESULTS.md.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: Verify whether Codex local memories_1.sqlite created inside an allowlist shadow home is inactive under foreign_memory=yes; the live shadow probe found it as a regular local file, not a symlink, and the Codex phase should assert no foreign memory is read or written.

Ran and recorded Claude, Codex, Muse, and Grok provider spikes with CLI versions and settings; attached sanitized evidence to the epic; recorded the Codex shadow memory database finding as a proposed follow-up; verified No --epic-symbol entries for sase-1ko.1. has no leftovers.
